question: Within the three previously authenticated original CC0 single-ZIP stork GPS cohorts, is there support for independently observed tags in the same UTC hour and the same predeclared coarse geographical grid cell? Source opportunity only; never social cue reception.
source: Bontekoe et al (2023) original archived GPS data, DOI 10.1098/rspb.2023.1268, three separate source CC0 archives
original_subset: Exactly same smallest one GPS ZIP per cohort as in PR421, NOT all original GPS ZIPs or complete study population

granularity.UTC_hour: same UTC calendar date and clock hour (floor to hour). Neither exact simultaneous GPS fixes nor individual contact timing.
granularity.spatial_primary: same 0.1 degree latitude x 0.1 degree longitude rectangle, anchored at -90,-180; floor bins
granularity.spatial_sensitivity: same 0.2 degree latitude x 0.2 degree longitude rectangle with same origin
granularity.boundary: Matching discrete grid cells misses close points in adjacent cells. Cell dimensions in kilometers vary by latitude; this is NOT a 10-km or 20-km distance test.

unit_and_response.co_observation_unit: unique UTC-hour × quantized lat-lon cell, regardless of how many GPS event rows are in the same bin
unit_and_response.per_cohort: number of hour-cells with valid georeferenced records; number of hour-cells with at least 2 distinct tag-local-identifiers; years with coverage
unit_and_response.between_cohorts: number of UTC hours in common and number of same UTC-hour × same coarse grid-cell keys in common for all three cohort pairs and all three cohorts
unit_and_response.same_tag_caveat: Cross-study tag IDs can be reused; do NOT infer these are independent birds or same animals; source-origin grouping, not individual join.
unit_and_response.no_sampled_rows: All original main GPS CSV event rows in the exact three selected public archives, no sample outcome-cherry-picking

qualifying_event: Same criterion as PR421: parseable UTC timestamp <=2026-11-24, nonempty tag string, finite lat [-90,90] and lon [-180,180]. 'visible' not used to exclude events, and its counts remain auditable in PR421.
output: per cohort source row/valid row and timestamp UTC-day counts against previous authenticated receipts
per cohort n distinct UTC hours with GPS, n distinct 0.1/0.2 degree hour-cells and n of these hour-cells with at least two tags
per cohort pair and triple n UTC hours in common and n hour-cell keys in common at BOTH predeclared grid resolutions
yearly aggregate counts for each spatial/temporal gate; NO individual GPS rows, source coordinates, cell keys or tag strings
all 3 original full-ZIP MD5 and main-member CRC checks, with only aggregate receipt stored
blocker: Original GPS source field mismatch, MD5 mismatch, or daily support mismatch closes this lane with no cell overlap claim. A positive count is only coarse data-support opportunity, not bird social information.
biological_claim_not_licensed: same UTC hour and grid-cell does not prove exact same time or interacting flock
tag string does not safely join across source studies
coarse cell geometry and observation errors prevent direct contact distance claims
no independently measured predecision cue predictive q, downstream actionability r or payoff/fitness effect
earlier Bronnvik 2024 already reports experience-linked conspecific density route selection
